Respond to telephone, email and face-to-face enquiries in a timely and professional manner. Liaise with clinicians, nurses, GPs and other healthcare professionals to support patient care. The Outpatient Receptionist/Administration Assistant will provide a comprehensive reception and administrative support service across outpatient reception areas at Weston General Hospital, ensuring patients, relatives and visitors receive a professional, welcoming and efficient service. title: Medical Receptionist
description: We are looking for friendly, organised and enthusiastic Receptionists to join our team at Penn Hill Surgery. title: Ward Administrator
description: This is an exciting role front of house, working closely with clinical colleagues to ensure our patients receive the highest standard of care. The role requires someone who has a great level of attention to detail and good organisational skills for managing in a busy environment. Excellent communication and customer service skills are essential for dealing with colleagues, patients and families. The needs of the service user will be the utmost priority. The principle of high quality customer care is at the heart of this role. Working hours can be flexible to cover a mixture of the following: 08.00 -- 18.30 Monday -- Friday 08.00 -- 13.00 Saturday -- Sunday Please note - we will be closing this post early if we receive a high volume of applications. The post holder will be required to admit/discharge and transfer patients, answer telephone enquiries, create appointments and arrange transport for patients.The post holder will be responsible for ensuring the reception area is tidy and well organised and that office supplies and stationery are ordered and kept stocked up.
